name: outline-mindmap
description: Turn the notes you already have into a mind map. Open a Markdown outline (headings and nested bullet lists), an indented text file or an OPML export; the central topic, main branches and sub-topics are laid out automatically on both sides or to the right, each branch in its own colour. Rename or re-level nodes, hide some, add new ones, recolour a branch, then export a crisp SVG and PNG, plus OPML and FreeMind (.mm) files you can keep editing in other mind-map apps, and a cleaned-up Markdown outline. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把现成的笔记一键变成思维导图。打开 Markdown 大纲（标题加多级列表）、缩进文本或 OPML 文件，自动排出中心主题、主分支和子主题，可以左右展开或只向右展开，每个分支一种颜色。可以改节点文字或层级、隐藏节点、新增节点、给分支换颜色，然后导出清晰的 SVG 和 PNG，以及能在其他思维导图软件里继续编辑的 OPML 和 FreeMind（.mm）文件，还有整理后的 Markdown 大纲。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
